The company serves manufacturing steel, cutting tool industry, chemicals, fertilizers, polymers, drug intermediaries, metal pressing, effluent treatment, and irrigation industries. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India. Graphite India Limited is a subsidiary of The Emerald Company Ltd.
